name: China Nonferrous Metal Industry's Foreign Engineering and Construction Co.,Ltd.
summary: China Nonferrous Metal Industry's Foreign Engineering and Construction Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the project contracting and mineral resource development in China and internationally. It operates through the Non-ferrous Metals Mining and Smelting, Contracting Engineering, and Equipment Manufacturing and Trading segments. The company is involved in non-ferrous metals business consulting; non-ferrous metals industrial design and research and development; non-ferrous metals trade; mineral resources exploration; mineral investment, production, and operation; mining and processing; smelting; metallurgical industry equipment manufacturing; international project contracti…
